sentences.text: The learned counsel appearing for the petitioner submits that the relief sought for, in this Writ Petition, had become infrucutuous, and hence, he seeks permission of this Court to withdraw the Writ Petition.
In view of such submission, permission is granted and the Writ Petition is dismissed as infructuous.
No costs.
Consequently, connected Miscellaneous Petition is closed.
